governor.browser_method: Windows hardware Chrome/ANGLE D3D11, injected memory samples, real animation/resource-check timers; continuous playback recovers critical -> reduced -> balanced -> full.
changes: Separate active cadence pressure from CPU submission headroom so target cadence can recover.
Require three consecutive expensive-geometry checks; healthy samples reset the streak.
Retain emergency memory/swap protection, capacity floors and existing point/pixel/FPS limits.

bulk_import.scope: Fresh, non-aggregated staging stores; existing nonempty append and aggregation paths retain general insertion.
changes: Bounded multi-row insertion preserving event IDs, original attributes and validation.
Retain primary/unique constraints, build secondary indexes after loading.
Spool search/spatial rows in disk-backed TEMP tables and populate their indexes in complete passes.
Bounded 128 MiB main / 16 MiB TEMP cache targets during import; restore normal cache targets before publication.
correctness: Full Rust matrix including import review, append, save/open and transactions.
2,205-event exact parity against general insertion: event/attribute rows, search text/results, spatial rows/results, canonical indexes, u64 IDs, fractions, missing locations and polygon centroids.
Duplicate failure and cancelled index construction roll back rows and schema; retry succeeds.

comparison.method: Sequential fresh optimized Windows CLI sessions; same warm synthetic CSV; baseline and modified binaries alternate. 100k: three repetitions each; 1m: one each. Complete command-response timing; import private-resident sampling at 200 ms.

million_comparison.method: Sequential fresh optimized Windows CLI sessions; same warm synthetic CSV; baseline and modified binaries alternate. 100k: three repetitions each; 1m: one each. Complete command-response timing; import private-resident sampling at 200 ms.

limitations: Only Windows was executed here; no macOS build/visual acceptance.
The governor integration test is browser-based; it is not a rebuilt native Tauri package test.
CSV/OS caches are warm; single-host results, three paired 100k repetitions and one paired million-event sample.
Faster ingestion uses a larger bounded cache than the original 32 MiB target; measured process peaks are included.
Source promotion does not publish a new installer or replace existing release assets.
The separate resident GPU VFX prototype remains local and is excluded from this change.
